attchmntText: NIBE Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Mini Diamonds India Limited filed its unaudited consolidated financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved the results on November 14, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations grew 64.26 percent to 41,071.34 lakhs. Profit before tax increased 41.76 percent to 800.33 lakhs. Profit after tax rose 27.37 percent to 560.56 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at 0.24. Paid-up equity share capital is 4,713.82 lakhs with a face value of 2 rupees per share. The company allotted 11,78,45,580 bonus shares on June 17, 2026. Results were published in Business Standard and Navrashtra on November 16, 2026. Nibe Limited also published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The publication appeared in Business Standard and Navrashtra on November 16, 2026.

attchmntText: NIBE Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mrs. Shilpa Ajay Bhatia as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 14, 2026.
voiceSummary: Nibe Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a consolidated net loss after tax of 1,081.49 lakhs for the half year. Revenue from operations stood at 14,339.36 lakhs. The board approved the appointment of Mrs. Shilpa Ajay Bhatia, DIN 10377934, as Additional Director and Non-Executive Independent Director for five years starting November 14, 2026. This appointment is subject to shareholder approval. The meeting concluded at 02:03 p.m. on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Nibe Limited has informed about Monitoring Agency Report for September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Nibe Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with BSE and NSE. Crisil Ratings Limited submitted the report regarding the utilization of proceeds from the Preferential Issue. The total issue size was Rs 251.85 crore. The company received Rs 157.36 crore as of September 30, 2026. Rs 155.34 crore was utilized during the period. Rs 96.51 crore remains unutilized. Funds were deployed for capital expenditure, repayment of borrowing, working capital, and general corporate purposes. Rs 2.02 crore was invested in mutual funds. The remaining Rs 94.49 crore is payable by warrant holders upon conversion. Warrants must be exercised by September 4, 2027. There were no deviations from the objects of the issue.

attchmntText: NIBE Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Nibe Limited reports no deviation or variation in the utilization of funds raised through Preferential Allotment on July 14, 2026. The company also discloses fund raising dates of 05/03/2026, 08/06/2026, and 14/07/2026, with a total amount raised of Rs. 1,573,600,750. The statement covers the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Funds were utilized for capital expenditure, repayment of existing borrowing, augmenting working capital, and GCP. Specific utilization figures include Rs. 3,600.00 lakhs for capital expenditure, Rs. 7,500.00 lakhs for repayment, Rs. 2,311.00 lakhs for working capital, and Rs. 2,122.48 lakhs for GCP. An unutilized amount of Rs. 2,53,008/- remains in the company's current account as of September 30, 2026. Additionally, 75% of warrant subscription is pending for 10,01,500 warrants. The monitoring agency is Crisil Ratings Limited. No comments from the audit committee or auditors are required.

attchmntText: NIBE Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Nibe Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a consolidated net loss after tax of 1,081.49 lakhs for the half year. Revenue from operations stood at 14,339.36 lakhs. The board also approved the appointment of Mrs. Shilpa Ajay Bhatia, DIN 10377934, as an Additional Director and Non-Executive Independent Director. This appointment is effective from November 14, 2026, for a term of five years. It is subject to shareholder approval. The meeting concluded at 02:03 p.m. on November 14, 2026.
